_comment: Hand-set values merged into catalog.json by tools/sync_catalog.py (keys starting with _ are ignored).

polytrack._why: Polytrack loads webpack chunks, a physics worker and its physics library on the fly. The arcade downloads them first so it can hand them to the game.

minecraft-classic._why: Plays classic.minecraft.net, which the arcade cannot test offline: offer that site in a tab as a fallback.

vent-crawlers-beta._why: Runs on arcade.makecode.com: offer its share page in a tab as a fallback.

arrow-battles._why: Runs on arcade.makecode.com: offer its share page in a tab as a fallback.

suggestion-box._why: Embeds a Microsoft Forms page: offer the form in a tab as a fallback.
